title: Bias Analysis of L2 Speaking Assessment Systems Using Concept Activation Vectors

bias_targets.methodology: Using Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) and Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to measure the gradient-based sensitivity of the model's predicted L2 speaking proficiency score to the speaker's first language (L1) concepts (e.g., Dutch, Gujarati, etc.).

Extracting Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) and evaluating sparse latent space representations (SAEs) to determine if the model's predicted speaking score is sensitive to a binary gender concept (female).

Employing Concept Activation Vectors (CAVs) and Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to evaluate the gradient-based sensitivity of the predicted proficiency score to the speaker's age group (e.g., <= 30 years old).
